b0116-heading-01.sourcePreview: When not to use a stream

b0117-text-01.machineText: *对于请求/响应，请使用绑定。*流适用于连续或非请求触发的数据；对于返回值的调用，使用绑定方法更简单。
b0117-text-01.sourcePreview: *For request/response, use bindings.* Streams are for continuous or unsolicited data; a call that returns a value is simpler as a bound method.

b0118-text-01.machineText: *对于应用事件，请使用`Emit`/`On`。*事件会分发给每个监听器，并由一套独立且成熟的系统处理。流是点对点的。
b0118-text-01.sourcePreview: *For application events, use `Emit`/`On`.* Events fan out to every listener and are a separate, well-worn system. Streams are point-to-point.

b0119-text-01.machineText: *不适用于`InitialHTML`窗口。*这些窗口通过`origin === "null"`加载，因此根本无法访问资产服务器。
b0119-text-01.sourcePreview: *Not available for `InitialHTML` windows.* Those load with `origin === "null"`, so they cannot reach the asset server at all.
